Guides translate scales back into something a reader can decode: axes, legends, and colourbars.
These examples rotate and dodge crowded tick labels, add log-scale minor ticks and secondary axes, and control legend order, alignment, and placement down to an arbitrary canvas offset.
A guide earns its space only when the reader needs it; drop the legend entirely once series are labelled directly.
Every example ships its full source: click **View source** to copy it.
